orderEmailSubjectEn: Your Order Has Been Confirmed - Voice Culture
orderEmailBodyEn:
Dear {customerName},

Thank you for your order! We have received your order #{orderNumber} and will begin preparing it right away. Made-to-order items require 3-5 business days of production before shipping.

Your package will be shipped via cross-border logistics and we will send you a tracking number once it is dispatched.

Thank you for choosing Voice Culture!
orderEmailSubjectZh: 您的订单已确认 - 成都造物
orderEmailBodyZh:
尊敬的 {customerName}，

感谢您的订单！我们已收到您的订单 #{orderNumber}，会立即开始制作。定制款需 3~5 个工作日生产后发货。

您的包裹将通过跨境物流发出，发货后我们会发送物流追踪号码给您。

感谢您选择成都造物！
